name: Temporal Hierarchical Index Tree
definition: A search index structure for isosurface extraction in time-varying scalar fields that utilizes temporal coherence to adaptively coalesce cell extreme values over time, reducing storage overhead and I/O compared to storing indices for every time step individually.
summary: The Temporal Hierarchical Index Tree is a search structure for efficient isosurface extraction in time-varying fields that reduces storage by adaptively coalescing cell values over time intervals.
